metric_definitions.wait: start - submit; all submitted jobs, including those completing after day 90
metric_definitions.allocation_rate: allocated resource-seconds / physical capacity-seconds; simulated allocation, not measured hardware utilization
metric_definitions.completion_convention: completed end<=H; running start<=H<end; waiting start>H (after events at H)
metric_definitions.queue_gpu_requests: requested_model; whole-job GPUs on [submit,start), including migrants before they start
metric_definitions.idle_queue_integration: Exact constant-interval integration after aggregating all events at the same time; no sampling
metric_definitions.stranded_upper_bound: Integral min(fixed-donor idle GPUs,A10 queued GPUs); an upper bound on matching idle GPUs on this realized timeline, ignoring compatibility/CPU/packing, not on alternative-schedule gains
metric_definitions.own_queue_idle_fraction: Conditional idle fraction: own-queue idle GPU-seconds / (pool GPUs * own-queue-nonempty seconds); null if the queue is never nonempty
metric_definitions.own_queue_idle_capacity_time_fraction: Own-queue idle GPU-seconds / (pool GPUs * entire horizon seconds)
metric_definitions.a10_queue_idle_fraction: Conditional idle fraction during A10 queue time; null if A10 never queues
metric_definitions.allocation_imbalance: Range across all available pools; signed A10 minus GPU-capacity-weighted fixed-donor allocation rate
metric_definitions.duration_eligible: Compatible A10 jobs passing the original-duration filter; independent of whether they queue, become old enough, fit or actually migrate
